## PR checklist

- [ ] CI passes for Node 18 and 20 (GitHub Actions)
- [ ] Build completes locally on a Steam Deck (Option A in README)
- [ ] Docs updated (README or docs/) where applicable
- [ ] No production-native binaries or platform-specific runtime deps
- [ ] Owner / reviewer: confirm runtime behavior in Deck (apply presets, graphics writer toggles)

> To enable automatic merge after CI passes, add the label `automerge` to this PR (repository permissions required).
